assist_opening: LynkAssist is answering, with this screen in view.
case_opened: Support case opened. Answers come in Chats.
chart_down: Down {pct}% from the start of the period.
chart_flat: Unchanged from the start of the period.
chart_up: Up {pct}% from the start of the period.
find_or_do_hint: Search products, customers, orders, reports, settings and help, or type an action
needs_net: Needs a connection: payment requests and sending chats.
never_blocks_person: Self-service never blocks reaching a person.
no_articles: No articles for this screen yet.
notify_done: We will tell you once, when it arrives.
presentation_only: Changes only how things are shown. Your data stays the same.
shortcut_hint: On a computer: press / to open this.
state_coming_soon_body: This service switches on by itself once a licensed partner is signed in your country.
state_empty_body: When you add something, it appears here.
state_error_body: Nothing was lost. Try again, or ask for help.
state_maintenance_body: This part is being updated. Selling and everything saved on your device keep working.
state_no_results_body: Try other words or fewer filters.
state_not_found_body: The address may have changed. Search for what you need, or go home.
state_offline_body: Keep working. Everything is saved on this device and sent when you are back online.
state_permission_body: Ask the owner of this business to give you this permission.
state_sync_pending_body: Your changes are saved here and will be sent when the connection is back.
support_connecting: Connecting you to a person at LynkOmni Support.
username_bad_character: Only letters a to z, numbers, full stops and underscores.
username_double_dot: No two full stops in a row.
username_held_for_review: This looks like a reserved name and will be reviewed.
username_hint: 3 to 30 characters: letters, numbers, full stops and underscores.
username_leading_or_trailing_dot: A full stop cannot be first or last.
username_rule: Shown as @name. It stays yours forever; old links keep working if you change it.
username_web_address_ending: That ending looks like a web address.
weak_note: Weak connection: the device sends when it can. Sales go first.
will_translate_online: Will translate when you are back online
writes_in: {name} writes in {from}. Messages are translated into {to} for you.
why_override: You chose this view for this device. Choose Automatic to go back.
why_registered: This is how this device was registered to the business.
why_reported: Chosen from what this device reports: its screen and how you use it.
why_safe_default: This device did not say enough, so the view that works with every kind of input is used.
view_owner_only: Only the owner can change the view of a selling device.
view_waits: The new view starts after this step.
kp_state_queued: Saved on this device and waiting to be sent.
kp_state_sent: Sent and waiting for an answer.
kp_state_confirmed: Final: the provider or partner confirmed it.
kp_state_failed: It did not go through. Nothing was charged or changed.
pin_locked: This device is locked after too many wrong PINs.
pin_wait: Wrong PIN. Try again in {s} seconds.
pin_wrong: Wrong PIN. {n} tries left before the device locks.
pin_locked_how: Nothing was deleted. Unlock it with your recovery code, from another signed-in device or by recovering your account online.
match_show_title: Show this number to the new device
match_show_note: The person on the new device taps the same number.
match_pick_title: Tap the number shown on the other device
match_pick_note: If no number matches, stop: someone else may be trying to get in.
match_ok: The numbers match. This device may now be used.
match_wrong: The numbers do not match. Nothing was allowed.
ntf_basis_security: It is about the safety of your account, so it is always sent.
ntf_basis_safety: Someone may be in danger, so it is always sent.
ntf_basis_legal: The law or the terms require it.
ntf_basis_transaction: It is part of something you did or asked for.
ntf_basis_opt_in: You chose to receive these. You can stop them at any time.
ntf_can_turn_off: You can turn this kind off in your notification settings.
ntf_cannot_turn_off: This kind cannot be turned off, because it protects you or others.
msg_never_ask: LynkOmni never asks for your password, codes or card number by message.
msg_no_tracking: We do not track whether you open our messages.
as_why_not_registered: LynkAssist cannot do this. It is not one of the things it is allowed to do.
as_why_switched_off: This has been switched off for now.
as_why_role: Your role does not allow this. Ask the owner.
as_why_hand_over: A person or the licensed partner decides this, so it has been prepared for them.
as_why_ask_owner: The owner asked to approve this first.
as_why_fresh_check: First, a quick check that it is you.
as_why_confirm: Check the details, then confirm or deny.
as_why_allowed: This is allowed and can be undone.
as_why_unknown: I do not know this. Here is where to find out.
as_why_never: This is never given out, to protect you.
as_no_answer: No answer on this device. Ask again when you are online, or chat with a person.
as_from_device: Answered on this device, from the help saved on {date}.
as_ask_hint: Ask a question or describe a problem
as_why_later: This needs the network and a person or partner. It is prepared and sent when you are online.
as_why_network: This touches your account, so it waits for the network.
ppl_idcn_wrong: Your IDCN does not match. {n} tries left.
ppl_checker_notice: Please make sure the checker you select is on site.
ppl_scan_to_answer: Scan to answer on your phone.
ppl_setup_just_me_help: For yourself, on your own devices.
ppl_setup_one_place_help: One shop, office or site with its own devices.
ppl_setup_many_places_help: Branches or departments, each with its own sections and devices.
ppl_setup_note: You can change this at any time. Prices, limits and rules stay the same.
ppl_owner_manager_only: Only the owner or a manager can add a device.
ppl_pair_code: On the new device, open LynkOmni and type this code:
ppl_pair_note: A code works once and ends after 10 minutes.
ppl_flag_checker_not_checked_in: The checker was not checked in.
ppl_door_offline: Works without internet. Saved on this device and sent when the link is back.
ppl_door_pin_wrong: That PIN is not known here. Please try again.
ppl_door_paused: Too many tries. Please wait a minute or see a manager.
ppl_door_finger: Put your finger on the reader
ppl_reader_sandbox: Sandbox reader: choose what the reader reports.
ppl_door_blocked: Your PIN is paused. A manager can help.
ppl_codes_left: {n} ticket numbers ready on this device
ppl_priority: Priority: older person, pregnancy or disability
ppl_works_offline: Works without internet: this device holds its own ticket numbers.
ppl_after_payment_help: Shown on the customer screen after a payment is confirmed. One tap, never required.
ppl_good_share: {share}% said good or very good, give or take {margin} points.
ppl_too_few: Results show from {n} answers, so no one can be singled out.
ppl_at_backup_face_failed: Face failed, so the next means was used.
ppl_at_backup_finger_failed: Finger failed, so IDCN was used.
ppl_at_backup_face_not_working: Face is not working on this device, so the next means was used.
ppl_at_backup_finger_not_working: Finger is not working on this device, so the next means was used.
ppl_at_show_note: Every time a PIN is shown or sent is recorded.
ppl_at_needs_online: This needs the internet. It will work when the link is back.
ppl_at_sandbox_delete: Sandbox: the person asks to delete their details
ppl_at_sandbox_dispute: Sandbox: the person raises a dispute
ppl_at_sandbox_late: Sandbox: it is 2 hours after the shift
ppl_at_sandbox_clock: Sandbox: this device's clock is wrong
ppl_at_group_warn: This PIN group is almost full. Start a new PIN group.
ppl_at_group_note: One branch or one event is one PIN group. A PIN is never given twice and never used again.
ppl_at_req_note: You are reminded after 7, 14 and 25 days. After 30 days with no action, the details are deleted by themselves.
ppl_at_step_details: The person and their ID document
ppl_at_idcn_made: The IDCN is made from the ID number.
ppl_at_too_few: This ID document has too few numbers. Please register another ID document for this person.
ppl_at_not_allowed: This set is not allowed in this country.
ppl_at_limit: This plan covers {n} people. Choose a bigger plan to add more.
ppl_at_reader_needed: A fingerprint reader is needed for this person. Connect a fingerprint reader to this device to continue.
ppl_at_camera_needed: A camera is needed for this person.
ppl_at_set_note: The set is chosen with the person's agreement. Everyone has an IDCN as backup.
ppl_at_agree_text: I agree to the means in my set. Sharing my PIN or IDCN with anyone, or checking in for someone else, is cheating on attendance.
ppl_at_agree_full_id_number: Or type the full ID number (not the IDCN)
ppl_at_id_mismatch: That is not the full ID number on file.
ppl_at_no_enrolment: Nothing to enrol for IDCN only.
ppl_at_pin_note: LynkOmni creates the PIN. Nobody types or chooses it.
ppl_at_send_note: The PIN and the IDCN go together, only to the person's own contact.
ppl_at_flag_note: These are only flags, never an accusation. You decide.
ppl_at_hand_note: Only when every means failed. A reason is always recorded, and you can never check yourself in.
ppl_at_correct_note: A correction keeps the old record beside the new one.
ppl_at_guardian: A child with a parent or guardian
ppl_at_visitor_needed: Type the visitor's name and pick who they are visiting.
ppl_at_visitor_note: Check the visitor's ID document. No photo is taken. Without an ID document, the manager must allow the visit.
ppl_at_fire_note: Everyone inside, staff and visitors, to tick off at the meeting point. Works without internet.
ppl_at_checker_note: Trusted people on site. A person never sees their own name in the list.
ppl_at_no_check_out_rule: A record still open 2 hours after the shift ends (at midnight without shifts) is marked "No check-out". The person is reminded and you fix the time.
ppl_at_leave_note: A check-in during approved leave is flagged.
ppl_at_event_limit: This plan has reached its number of events.
ppl_at_cert_tier: Certificates come with LynkAttend Pro and Max.
ppl_at_cert_note: Anyone can check a certificate is real with its code.
ppl_at_only_added: Only a door device you added can check people in.
ppl_at_lock_note: A locked device can no longer check anyone in. Everything on it is encrypted.
ppl_at_clock_note: When a device comes online with a wrong clock, its records are marked for you to correct.
ppl_at_country_allows: Face and Finger allowed in this country
ppl_at_bill_note: Only people who checked in at least once this month are counted. Visitors are free.
ppl_at_already_in: You are already checked in. Press Check out when you leave.
ppl_at_not_in: You are not checked in today.
ppl_at_wty_in: You checked in at {time}. Not you? Tap Not me.
ppl_at_wty_out: You checked out at {time}. Not you? Tap Not me.
ppl_qu_join_anywhere_help: People can take a ticket from home with the link.
ppl_qu_join_only_help: People scan the QR code on the calling screen. It changes every few minutes.
ppl_qu_balance_help: Priority is for older people, people with a disability, pregnant women and emergencies.
ppl_qu_public_help: Shows the tickets being served, how many are waiting and about how long. Ticket numbers only.
ppl_qu_public_off: The public queue page is switched off.
ppl_qu_only_here: You can join only at the place. Scan the QR code on the calling screen.
ppl_qu_plan_free: When the limit is reached, tickets keep working until closing that day. A paid plan is needed for the rest of the month.
ppl_qu_plan_paid: Nobody is turned away: each extra 1,000 tickets cost {price}.
ppl_qu_plan_extra_place: Each extra place costs {price} a month.
ppl_qu_extra_tickets: {n} tickets above the plan this month.
ppl_qu_bill_note: Only a place that gave out at least one ticket this month is counted. A visit that uses Send to is one ticket.
ppl_qu_plan_sections: Your plan allows {n} sections in a place.
ppl_qu_plan_counters: Your plan allows {n} counters in a place.
ppl_qu_plan_hardware: Printers, keypads, pagers and scanners need a paid plan.
ppl_qu_plan_send_to: Send to another section needs a paid plan.
ppl_qu_plan_forecast: The busy-hour forecast needs a paid plan.
ppl_qu_plan_way: This way to join needs a paid plan.
ppl_qu_code_help: Use 3 letters or numbers, without O, I, 0 or 1. Example: LAB.
ppl_qu_code_used: This code is already used here.
ppl_qu_counter_order: Press a section to add or remove it. The first section in the list is served first.
ppl_qu_suggest_open: {section} wait is over {m} minutes. Open another counter?
ppl_qu_fair: Call next follows the fair order. Staff never choose who comes next.
ppl_qu_history_note: Every action is kept. Records are never changed quietly.
ppl_qu_did_keeper_changed: Another device became the queue keeper
ppl_qu_keeper_help: One device in the building keeps the queue, so the order stays right without internet. Every other device follows it.
ppl_qu_keeper_standby: Another added device takes over by itself, with the same queue and its own ticket numbers.
ppl_qu_keeper_none: No other device can take over now. Add a reception or counter device while online.
ppl_qu_no_display_note: A device with no screen is added through the device it is connected to.
ppl_qu_reports_daily_summary: Your plan shows a daily summary.
ppl_qu_reports_full: Your plan has full reports by section, counter, staff member and hour.
ppl_qu_reports_by_email: Your plan has full reports, also sent by email.
ppl_qu_reports_custom: Your plan has custom reports and full download.
ppl_qu_forecast_line: Tomorrow {from} to {to} will be busy at {section}.
ppl_qu_forecast_note: From this place's own past days.
ppl_qu_check_priority: Priority is used much more often here than by others.
ppl_qu_check_put_back: Put back is used much more often here than by others.
ppl_qu_check_note: This is only a flag, never an accusation. The manager decides.
ppl_qu_close_help: Tickets still waiting are closed and marked "Not served today". A ticket is for today only.
ppl_qu_free_limit: This month's free tickets are used. A paid plan is needed.
ppl_qu_one_per_phone: This phone already has a waiting ticket for this section.
ppl_qu_no_codes: This device has no ticket numbers left. Connect to the internet to get more.
ppl_qu_may_not: You may not be served today.
ppl_qu_follow: Scan to follow the queue on your phone.
ppl_qu_no_printer: No printer added. Show or send the ticket number.
ppl_qu_put_back_help: Goes back in after the next {n} people.
ppl_qu_put_back_late: More than {m} minutes have passed. A new ticket is needed.
ppl_qu_check_scan: Scan the ticket's QR code or type its number.
ppl_qu_kiosk_pick: Where do you need to go?
ppl_qu_kiosk_note: No name or phone number is needed.
ppl_qu_qr_changes: This code changes every few minutes.
ppl_qu_no_account: No app and no account needed.
ppl_qu_way_smartphone: Open the link or scan the QR code at the door.
ppl_qu_way_whatsapp: Send "Hi" to the place's number and pick the section.
ppl_qu_way_lynkchat: Send "Hi" to the place in LynkChat and pick the section.
ppl_qu_way_basic_phone: Dial the short code or send a text message. You get a text when your turn is near.
ppl_qu_late_help: Running late moves you back {n} places, once.
ppl_qu_late_used: Running late was already used for this ticket.
ppl_qu_msg_missed: We called you 3 times. Ask reception within {m} minutes to be put back.
ppl_qu_phone_privacy: Your phone number is used only for this ticket's messages and is deleted after 30 days.
